en: Black-and-white postcard showing a brick railway station building with ornate gables and a metal roof. A sign above the entrance reads "BRÄNNARP". There are railway tracks in the foreground, a wagon on the left, and several people standing on the platform. Handwritten cursive text covers the lower part of the image, with printed captions including the Swedish words "Stationen" and "Brännharp" (or Brännarp).
